name: @sredevopsorg/dsh-agent-opencode
description: OpenCode agent preset: every task is delegated to the OpenCode CLI through the `subagent_opencode` tool, because the agent holds no file or shell tools of its own. It binds the `opencode-preset` provider so it never collides with `@sredevopsorg/dsh-subagent-opencode`, and a host watcher answers output-token-limit cutoffs with `continue`. A Web settings page edits the watcher without touching YAML.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check auto-continue.js && node --check settings.js && node --check client.js && for f in test/*.test.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
